name: Audio Clips
description: Audio Clips API, compatible formats: MP3, WAV.
project_description:
Audio Clips module is an API for creating a clip from an audio file.

 Features 
 This module uses the FFmpeg library and only the MP3 and WAV formats are compatible.

 Post-Installation 
 - Go to /admin/config/media/audio-clips/types and add a new Audio Clip Type where you can specify a min and max duration.

- Call createAudioClip or updateAudioClip from AudioClipService to generate a clip, or instantiate AudioFile directly for lower-level audio operations.

 Additional Requirements 
 This project needs the FFmpeg (ffmpeg/ffprobe) CLI installed on the server or container.
